snippet.title: Mad Ever After Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Mad Ever After is a co-op action roguelite where classic fairy tales have fallen into darkness.

Team up with your friends, battle twisted enemies, collect powerful upgrades, and fight your way through a world where every run is different.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4518270/Mad_Ever_After/

Follow us for more updates!
